title: W. L. Teague — grocer
text:
W. L. TEAGUE.

W. L. Teague is also a successful groceryman and has customers who would not trade anywhere else. His weights, measures and prices are satisfactory, and his customerrs have confidence in his word and faith in his honesty. He is well established and enjoys a good trade. Mr. Teague also carries hardware and a big stock of furniture from which he realizes a good dividend.
notes: Spelling 'customerrs' preserved verbatim from original. This appears to be a business profile/advertisement feature from The Elk publication.
